summary: TREK is a self-hosted travel planner. It opened already signed in as Maya, so no sign-in prelude was needed. Saved 5 views: (1) dashboard: /dashboard with the live trip hero card, stats, trip grid and sidebar widgets (currency, collections, timezones, upcoming reservations); (2) trip-planner: /trips/2, the Mexico City trip with the day-plan sidebar, map with markers and the places list; (3) trip-costs: /trips/2, then click the Costs tab, showing balance cards, expense list with splits, settle-up and balances; (4) trip-collab: /trips/2, then click the Collab tab, showing chat, notes, links, polls and the what's-next timeline; (5) journey-detail: /journey/1, the Japan travel journal with a day timeline and route map. All five replayed with similarity 1.00. Not captured, as lower priority: Atlas, Vacay, Collections, the Bookings/Lists/Files tabs, Settings and Admin.
